name.en: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP CSSS)

summary.en: Rs.12,000 per year for graduation (first three years); Rs.20,000 per year for post-graduation. B.Tech/B.E.: Rs.12,000 for years 1 to 3 and Rs.20,000 in year 4

benefit.value_note: Rises to Rs.20,000 per year at post-graduation level

name.en: Income certificate (required only for fresh applicants)
Savings bank account in the student's own name (Aadhaar-seeded for DBT)

en: Register and apply online only on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). Applications sent directly to the Ministry are not accepted.
Your institute verifies the application first, then the State Nodal Agency.
Renewal each year needs at least 50% marks in the annual exam and at least 75% attendance.

to_confirm: Application window opens and closes on NSP each year; check scholarships.gov.in
Eligibility needs a Class XII percentile above 80 in your stream and board, and the course must be at an AICTE or regulator-recognised institution
Not available alongside any other scholarship, including state fee reimbursement
